eta_normalization: eta_repo=ln(numerical H0)+eta_relative; H_D=E exp(eta_repo)/(1-E chi_hat eta_z)

smooth_reference_transport.definition: y_smooth=y_original+O ln(chi_GL64/chi_legacy_interpolated); same O,C, supplied legacy g response retained
smooth_reference_transport.reason: analytic distance derivatives require a smooth reference; no differentiation of piecewise-linear quadrature tables

optical_image: polynomial eta only, after declared coherent-V decomposition; distance-defined, not physical Hcal
working_law: inherited white plus Planck18 linear-z0 correlated-PV covariance; no empirical selection/shared-calibration calibration

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions

five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

derivative_witness.scope: declared finite linear family and numerical rank; not a universal physical no-go

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

derivative_witness.scope: declared finite linear family and numerical rank; not a universal physical no-go

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

derivative_witness.scope: declared finite linear family and numerical rank; not a universal physical no-go

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

derivative_witness.scope: declared finite linear family and numerical rank; not a universal physical no-go

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

derivative_witness.scope: declared finite linear family and numerical rank; not a universal physical no-go

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

derivative_witness.scope: declared finite linear family and numerical rank; not a universal physical no-go

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

derivative_witness.scope: declared finite linear family and numerical rank; not a universal physical no-go

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

null_space.interpretation: minimum-norm representatives are not measurements of nonidentified functionals

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

calibration.constant_angular_scope: represented l<=2 only; omitted angular calibration can leak into radial coefficients

depth_eta_image.warning: Representative covariance is not bounded uncertainty in a null direction.

published_chart.scope: first-order deterministic published-q correction; not distance-deboost qualification

derivative_witness.scope: declared finite linear family and numerical rank; not a universal physical no-go

internal_predictive.reason: 27 training rows do not generically identify this full parameter family; J1 checks are predeclared

five_views.x: full signed carrier and eta depth vectors/tensors; NPZ retains nulls and joint covariance
five_views.Q_anchor: 95% fixed-C noise reference in nested identifiable angular-radial mean quotient; not physical MES
five_views.Pi_law: upper chi-square tail for the same nested fixed-C null; not truth probability
five_views.F: joint-region signed support intervals in depth_eta_image; unbounded on null directions
five_views.G_F: full correlated eta(z)-eta(.04) vector/STF path; nonlinear H_D image additionally uses derivative denominator
five_views.information: five views of one likelihood; no added or multiplied independent information
